repos.name: solongate/agent-security
repos.description: Local-first, open-source security gateway for AI coding agents. Enforce tool-call policies, detect secrets, and audit actions on-device.
repos.one_liner: A local-first security gateway designed to govern and audit AI coding agents.
bullets: Built in Go, focusing on low-latency interception of agent tool calls.
Provides policy enforcement and secret detection for autonomous coding workflows.
Ensures security and compliance for enterprise-grade AI agent deployments.
Acts as a middleware layer to audit and restrict agentic behavior on-device.

repos.name: voyager-so/vork
repos.description: Headless 3D and VFX engine for agents. Research preview.
repos.one_liner: A headless 3D and VFX engine specifically architected for AI agents.
bullets: Written in Rust for high-performance, memory-safe graphics processing.
Enables agents to perceive, manipulate, and render 3D environments programmatically.
Facilitates research in embodied AI and complex visual simulation tasks.
Provides a headless interface suitable for server-side agentic automation.

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, multiplayer code editor built for speed and collaboration.
bullets: Engineered in Rust with a custom GPU-accelerated UI framework.
Features native support for real-time collaboration and AI-assisted coding.
Optimized for low-latency input and massive codebase navigation.
Essential infrastructure for modern developer productivity and remote engineering teams.

repos.name: leo1oel/lattice
repos.description: A local-first, agent-first LaTeX writing app for macOS: live PDF, annotations, papers and Overleaf sync
repos.one_liner: A local-first, agent-first LaTeX writing environment for macOS.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture focusing on local-first data persistence.
Integrates live PDF rendering, annotation tools, and Overleaf synchronization.
Designed to support agentic workflows for academic and technical document generation.
Streamlines the research-to-publication pipeline for quantitative professionals.

repos.name: anomalyco/rune
repos.one_liner: A native UI framework built in Rust for high-performance application development.
bullets: Leverages Rust's memory safety and performance for UI rendering.
Provides a modern alternative to traditional cross-platform UI toolkits.
Designed for building responsive, native-feeling applications across desktop platforms.
Focuses on developer experience and efficient resource utilization for complex interfaces.
